quote: To evaluate our models, we report the Macro F1 Score (Macro F1) to account for class imbalance. We also calculate the F1 Score for the classes individually.
we annotated 2864 instances with five annotators (all student assistants, with specializations in social science or computer science). The annotation was performed over a duration of nine months.
guideline: We first select a high-level category (solidarity, anti-solidarity, mixed, none). Solidarity or anti-solidarity cases are then further distinguished into frames as defined by : group-based, compassionate, exchange-based, and empathic.
